question:
Re-read each record against its first-party page and establish the values its unknown classes name, at least the retention and per-object-cap notes, plus any interface, chaining, retention, per-object-cap or egress value listed for it.
An audit of the first attempt judged these claims unsupported by their sources; settle each one first:
- storage/internet-archive-bittorrents $.per_object_cap.notes: Page states no 1 TB per-item cap; that figure is not in this capture (it is on the uploading-tips page). Claim cites the wrong source for the 1 TB part.
- storage/internxt-lifetime $.limits_note: Page says plans stack; the StackSocial 'new users ONLY / NOT stackable' fine print and the write-gated CLI constraint are not on this page. Value is an unresolved note, not confirmed by it.
- storage/interserver-storage-vps $.interface: SFTP is listed; NFS appears nowhere in the capture.
- storage/internxt-lifetime $.interface_detail: The quoted vendor sentence 'supports Rclone in two ways...' is not in the capture (page says three methods). rclone issue #7610 / internxt/cli#248 and missing COPY/PROPPATCH are not on the page. Only the Ultimate requirement and WebDAV/CLI/S3 methods appear.
- storage/internxt-lifetime $.per_object_cap.notes: Blog capture says nothing about per-file upload limits; the claimed limits are on the help.internxt.com page (see c10).
- storage/internet-archive-bittorrents $.chaining: Page supports webseeding only. IAS3 upload, 1 TiB/day load, ~1.7 MB/s per-connection shaping and 'only path to exceed' are not on it.
- storage/internxt-lifetime $.retention.notes: Page has lifetime/one-time payment, but nothing about a StackSocial page, 10 TB SKU, no renewal fees, or file expiry; cited quote is about stacking.
- storage/internet-archive-bittorrents $.egress.terms: Webseeding is stated; 'Free' and 'zero cost to anyone' are not stated on the page.
- storage/internxt-lifetime $.identity_cost.kind: Page says name and email only, no verification; 'card' is not an identity cost stated there (cards are for paid payment).
- storage/internet-archive-bittorrents $.limits_note: rTorrent, obsolete torrents, padding file are on page; 'bt1 trackers are rate-limited per IP' and 'generated server-side only' (no swarm choice) are not stated.
- storage/internxt-lifetime $.tooling: Native rclone on Ultimate and WebDAV via CLI are on page, but the page documents an Internxt S3-compatible object storage; 'No S3' is not stated and not a clean fit.
